description: E‑commerce platform offering REST and GraphQL APIs to manage products, orders, customers, and store settings.
access_requirements: Create a sandbox store and generate API credentials via Settings > API Accounts in the store control panel
evidence_excerpts: Use /abandoned-carts/{token} on headless storefronts to retrieve the cart_id ... you can use the REST Storefront API, the REST Management API, or the GraphQL Storefront API.
Add your API token to the authorization header in the following code sample ... 'Authorization' : `Bearer {{TOKEN}}`
Create a sandbox store ... Generate API credentials ... Navigate to Settings > API Accounts in your store control panel. Create credentials with the scopes you need.
Use REST and GraphQL APIs to manage products, orders, customers, and store settings programmatically.
